items.source: Covers functional correctness (do the right temperatures come back?) and structural correctness (is ToolCallingAdvisor actually in control of the loop?). The structural proof uses a AbstractToolCallingAdvisorAutoRegistrationIT.ChainIterationCountingAdvisor positioned just after the auto-registered ToolCallingAdvisor. Because the advisor recurses via chain.copy(this).nextCall(), the counting advisor is invoked once per tool-call iteration plus once for the final answer — a count > 1 proves the advisor chain owns the loop. When only the model's built-in path runs the count is always 1.
items.translation: 涵盖功能正确性（是否返回了正确的温度？）和结构正确性（ToolCallingAdvisor 是否真正控制循环？）。该结构证明使用了一个 AbstractToolCallingAdvisorAutoRegistrationIT.ChainIterationCountingAdvisor，其位置紧接在自动注册的 ToolCallingAdvisor 之后。由于该顾问通过 chain.copy(this).nextCall() 进行递归调用，计数顾问会在每次工具调用迭代时被触发一次，并在最终答案生成时再被触发一次——计数大于 1 即证明顾问链拥有循环控制权。当仅运行模型内置路径时，计数始终为 1。
